name: Korea Petroleum Industries Company
summary: Founded in 1964, Korea Petroleum Industries Company, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, specializes in the production and sale of diverse petroleum-based products. Its core business involves manufacturing and supplying asphalts, industrial solvents, and a broad spectrum of construction materials. Key offerings include blown asphalt and various building solutions such as tar and water-based polyurethane, waterstops, sheet membranes, adhesive tapes, cold patches, sealants, emulsions, primers, and ceramic powders, among other related items.
